per_selector_scope: Selection subsets exist only for the MMLU-target experiments. For --target bbh_heldout these are a pool-composition check, NOT the BBH experiment's subsets, which are not selected yet.
scope_note: This screen is POOL-WIDE: every one of the 270679 candidates is MinHash/LSH-probed against all 5209 BBH held-out eval split items and every collision is verified with exact shingle Jaccard. It supersedes the earlier L3, which only examined L2 13-gram suspects.
recall_caveat: LSH is probabilistic candidate generation: at 32 bands x 2 rows the NOMINAL detection probability is 1-(1-s^rows)^bands, i.e. 0.951 at J=0.3 and 0.99990 at J=0.5. Two separate reasons this is not a proof of absence: (1) LSH recall is <100% by construction; (2) the (a*h+b) mod (2^61-1) step runs in numpy uint64, so the multiply WRAPS and the family is not exactly min-wise independent -- the nominal figure assumes the ideal MinHash model. Every reported collision is still verified by EXACT shingle Jaccard, so there are no false positives; only recall is un-guaranteed.
